pickups.note: Issue #64: rides on the pit hauler, the old cargo droid that roams the pit (droids/droids.json, pit_hauler); its position here is only where it starts. taken_flag: set when someone takes it (Oda's rumor r_pit_hauler stops). Issue #210: 'inside': it is hidden inside the droid, not on it: no look, no glow, '[E] Open the cargo droid' when you reach it.

story.note: A story save: the jetpack lies on the cantina's lookout floor, on the ring 3.4 m from the energy blade in the middle (tower_blade), not in the pit hauler (which roams empty). Same id and taken flag, so a save that took it from the droid keeps it taken.

pickups.note: Issue #148: rides on the old cargo droid in the crashed starcruiser's deep hold (droids/droids.json, wreck.hauler); its position here is only where it starts.
Issue #210: a rifle the guards left lying on top of the barracks. Story saves only (freeplay has every gun). Taking it finishes the 'Steal a rifle' quest; the roof's riflemen see whoever comes up.
Issue #210: an energy blade somebody stashed on top of the cantina's stair tower (its top is 15 m up). Story saves only. Oda tells you about it after the droid merchant chapter.
A smuggler's drop outside the front gate: three cases of unmarked cells. Worth 180 cr to the fence, if you can get them past the checkpoint.

crate_note: Wreck field: a supply crate on the top deck (the bridge platform, the landing pad) of each crashed starcruiser (worlds/port_desert.json, kind 'wreck'). site_crates: where, as a point in that wreck's level frame (x, height v, stern-ward w; StarcruiserWreck.site_point). [E] opens it: one prize rolled from crate_prizes by weight (credits, or 'count' of an item, which needs a backpack slot). Opened once and it stays open (saved with the taken pickups).
note: Items lying in the town. Positions are a town marker plus an offset, so no coordinates live in code. The jetpack rides inside the pit hauler in free play and lies on top of the cantina tower in a story save (its 'modes' block). A pickup taken once stays taken (saved).

drops.note: Hiding places for Oda's smuggling run (board/bar_board.json, j_smuggle_run). Each run picks one area (never the same one twice in a row) and one spot in it. Oda only names the area, so the player has to search it. A spot is an offset from the area's marker. ground: snap the drop to the desert terrain. Drops have no glow ring, so out in the sand they are hard to spot. marked (issue #64): a drop in the streets or on a roof gets a beam of light over it, so it can be found in town. Issue #251: the job names which areas are its own ('areas' on the board): Oda's and the fence's run is the desert ones, the general's the alleys and the roofs. The HUD pointer goes to within 15 m of the drop itself (WorldState.DROP_NEAR), not to the area's marker.

areas.hint: out in the sand past the front gate
in the dunes outside the back gate
tucked in one of the alleys between the houses
up on one of the low house roofs. Bring something that flies
